The encoder found what's easiest to predict: the light, which doesn't change within a recording and at the same time tells one recording from another, and it threw the cup away. The H-JEPA authors call this slow-feature collapse: “slow” refers to what the encoder holds on to, not to the collapse itself. They saw it on real DROID recordings: the model kept the background and threw away the arm. Guessing the push makes the representations change together with the cup: the probe error is ${fmt(b.err * 100, 1)} cm. That's better than nothing, but worse than with a single light: in five hundred steps, it's hard for a small model to find the cup when the whole frame keeps getting brighter or darker.

На нашей модели вышло наоборот тому, что: On our model, the result is the opposite of what the idea of a JEPA suggests. The frame model stopped the cup ${cm(r.pix.dist)} cm from the goal: the morning light gets in its way, but the cup in the photo stands in the same spot. The representation model left the cup ${cm(r.rep.dist)} cm away: its encoder learned only from daytime frames, and it turns the morning photo into a representation unlike any it has ever seen, so the distance to it means nothing. The frame model passes only the current frame through its encoder and compares the photo pixel by pixel. A representation is only as useful as the data the encoder learned from was diverse: the V-JEPA 2 encoder saw over a million hours of video in every kind of light, and ours saw Ada's table in one.

JEPA — генеративная модель, которая рису: Is a JEPA a generative model that draws future frames?
Да: она предсказывает следующий кадр, то: Yes: it predicts the next frame, only more economically
Нет: она предсказывает представление буд: No: it predicts the representation of a future frame, and the pictures in illustrations are drawn by decoders trained separately and only for display
Да, если к ней подключить предиктор: Yes, if a predictor is attached to it
ЛеКун пишет, что JEPA предсказывает не с: LeCun writes that a JEPA predicts not y itself but its representation. In V-JEPA, DINO-WM and V-JEPA 2-AC, the decoder is trained separately, and in DINO-WM, letting the decoder's error into the predictor's training even made planning worse.
The loss of a JEPA fell almost to zero. Has the model learned the world?
Да: ошибка предсказания почти нулевая: Yes: the prediction error is almost zero
Да, если обучение шло долго: Yes, if training went on long enough
Не обязательно: если энкодер выдаёт всем: Not necessarily: if the encoder gives every frame the same representation, the error is zero, but the model knows nothing
Это коллапс представлений. В лаборатории: This is representation collapse. In Lab 1, the model without a defense had the lowest loss of all, and the probe couldn't find the cup from its representations. That's why a JEPA is checked with a second gauge: the spread of the representations and a probe.
Коллапс представлений — это то же самое,: Is representation collapse the same thing as mode collapse in AMP?
Нет: в AMP политика повторяет лишь часть: No: in AMP, the policy repeats only some of the motions from the recordings, while in representation collapse the encoder stops telling inputs apart
Да, это одно явление в разных статьях: Yes, it's one phenomenon in different papers
Да, оба лечатся скользящим средним: Yes, both are cured with a moving average
Схлопывание мод урока 6.2 — свойство сос: The mode collapse of lesson 6.2 is a property of adversarial training: out of many motions, the policy picks a few. Representation collapse is a degenerate solution of a JEPA in which the prediction error is zero on any data.
Штраф за разброс представлений решает пр: Does a penalty on the spread of the representations solve the collapse problem completely?
Да: раз представления разные, модель раз: Yes: since the representations differ, the model tells apart everything that matters
Нет: энкодер может держать разброс за сч: No: the encoder can keep up the spread with something that doesn't change within a recording, such as the light, and throw the cup away; guessing the action from two neighboring representations helps
Нет: штраф вообще не помогает, нужен тол: No: the penalty doesn't help at all, only a target encoder does
Это медленный коллапс из лаборатории 1 и: This is the slow-feature collapse of Lab 1 and of the H-JEPA paper: on DROID recordings without the inverse dynamics loss, the model kept the background and threw away the arm. Guessing the action makes the representations change together with what moves.
Пиксели как цель обучения точнее предста: Are pixels a more accurate training target than representations, since they contain everything?
Нет: у I-JEPA и V-JEPA цель в пространст: No: for I-JEPA and V-JEPA, a target in representation space gave a better encoder, and a model that reconstructs pixels spends effort on details that can't be predicted
Одинаково: важна только размерность: They're the same: only the dimension matters
У I-JEPA разница огромная, у V-JEPA на в: For I-JEPA the difference is huge, for V-JEPA on video it's smaller, but it favors representations in every comparison, and V-JEPA learns roughly twice as fast as models that predict pixels.
Чтобы робот планировал по картинке-цели,: For a robot to plan with a goal image, does it need thousands of hours of its own recordings with rewards?

Да, и только успешные попытки: Yes, and only of successful attempts
Нет: предиктор модели Meta учили на деся: No: the predictor of Meta's model was trained on dozens of hours of DROID video without rewards or success labels, and not a single attempt was recorded in the test labs
Энкодер учился на видео без действий, а: The encoder learned from video without actions, and the goal is set by an image: the distance to it in representation space replaces the reward. The DROID recordings contained both successful and failed attempts.
Если модель мира красиво раскатывает буд: If a world model rolls out the future beautifully, does it plan well?
Не обязательно: публичный чекпойнт модел: Not necessarily: the public checkpoint of Meta's model drew the future through a decoder no worse than the corrected model but planned much worse
Да: хорошая раскатка и есть хорошая моде: Yes: a good rollout is exactly what makes a good world model
Да, если раскатка длинная: Yes, if the rollout is long
Terver и соавторы показали, что успех пл: Terver et al. showed that the success of planning depends both on the planner's settings and on how the distance to the goal guides the search. In Lab 2, the frame model drew the table well, but far from the goal its distance didn't show which way to push.
Модель мира V-JEPA 2-AC работает с любой: Does the V-JEPA 2-AC world model work with any camera?
Да: энкодер видел миллион часов видео: Yes: the encoder saw a million hours of video
Да, если камера цветная: Yes, if the camera is in color
Нет: авторы вручную подбирали положение: No: the authors picked the camera position by hand, and the error in the action axes that the model infers from the frame grows almost linearly with the camera angle
Предиктор получает действия в осях робот: The predictor gets actions in the robot's axes but sees the scene through a single uncalibrated camera. If the robot's base isn't visible, it's hard to tell which way the axes point, and the model makes systematic errors.
